title: Concept: NuGet lockfile entry without a content hash
description: packages.lock.json declares a locked package that records no `contentHash`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Restore cannot verify the package it downloads against the lockfile, so a feed substitution installs silently.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.lock.json (nuget).
risk: Restore cannot verify the package it downloads against the lockfile, so a feed substitution installs silently.
